purpose: Teach: 腰痛/謝っ/微笑/寝よ/ほのか/凄かっ/冬場/軽やか

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、座りすぎで、腰痛、出てる。
lines.en: Club activities are killing my back—too much sitting.
lines.style: Offhand complaint with a wry edge. Throws it out casually, like she's barely noticed it herself, but there's real discomfort under the surface. Slight self-deprecating shrug in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日、後輩に、つい強く言いすぎたから、謝っておいた。
lines.en: I was too sharp with a junior today, so I went and apologized.
lines.style: Quiet accountability. Measured pace. No drama in it—just stating the fact of what he did. A small exhale after 'apologized,' like something in him settles.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の微笑、いつもみんなを和ませるよ。
lines.en: Your smile—it always puts everyone at ease.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through her usual guard. Soft opening, almost tender. Direct and undefended. The kind of thing she doesn't say often, so it lands heavier than it sounds.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今夜、早く寝ようと思う。
lines.en: I'm going to get to bed early tonight.
lines.style: Quiet decision, almost to himself. Calm, grounded tone. No urgency—just a gentle commitment. Like he's giving himself permission to rest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 制服に、ほのかな柔軟剤の香り、残ってる。
lines.en: Your uniform still has that faint fabric-softener smell on it.
lines.style: Observational, almost dreamlike. Slow, soft delivery. She's noticing small, tender details. There's something intimate in the observation without being forward about it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨夜のテレビ、最終回、凄かった。
lines.en: That TV finale last night was incredible.
lines.style: Sudden brightness. Energy shifts up. Genuine excitement, like he's still riding the high of it. Quick tempo, animated but not forced—authentic enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 冬場、家にこもりすぎないよう、外、歩こう。
lines.en: In winter, don't just hole up inside—get out and walk around.
lines.style: Practical encouragement, like she's looking out for him. Warm but not soft. The tone of someone who notices when people withdraw and gently nudges them back.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 明日、軽やかな気持ちで、登校しよう。
lines.en: Tomorrow, let's go to school with a light heart.
lines.style: Gentle closing. Warm, almost tender. He's offering something quiet but real—not cheerleading, just a soft invitation to move through tomorrow together. Slight rise at the end, like an opening.
